identity_modal.radios: input[name=actorSelector]: #select-self and #select-<page slug>, aria-checked marks the active one (page active by default)

admin_post_list.submit: button 'Kommentieren' (class comments-comment-box__submit-button--cr), present only once text is typed

member_post_view.comment_box: div[role=textbox][aria-label='Texteditor zum Erstellen von Kommentaren'] with Emoji, GIF, 'Foto teilen'; focused: still no identity control (measured as Super-Admin on an own member post and on a page post)
member_post_view.edit_dialog: author button '<page>', 'Mit allen teilen', 'Kommentare: Alle', text editor, 'Speichern' -- no media, alt-text or tag control

limits.english_interface: Setting the lang cookie to v=2&lang=en-us plus Accept-Language: LinkedIn rewrote the cookie to v=2&lang=de-de on the next load and served html lang=de; also with ?locale=en_US. Only the account setting switches the interface.
limits.page_composer_tags: Tag suggestions and the chosen pill carry no identifier (pill: 'button aria-label=<name> verwerfen', text only; no data attribute, no link).
limits.page_composer_video: Round 3: a 4 s 640x360 H.264 clip without audio kept 'Weiter' disabled for 20 s. Round 4: H.264/AAC 1280x720, 30 fps, 6 s, yuv420p, faststart (188 KB) -- editor 'Bearbeiten' with 'Untertitel', 'Weiter' enabled at once and still after 90 s, composer then shows a <video> preview, 'Medienvorschau bearbeiten', 'Medieninhalt entfernen', 'Posten' enabled. Built.
limits.messaging_mentions: '@' plus a name start in a 1:1 thread and in a group thread: an empty listbox, no options; the text stays plain.

page_composer_document.dialog: 'Dokumente teilen' with input[type=file]; after upload a title field (placeholder 'Fügen Sie einen aussagekräftigen Titel hinzu.'), 'Hochgeladenes Dokument entfernen', 'Fertig'

member_composer_video.editor: 'Editor' dialog with 'Video ansehen', 'Untertitel', 'Miniaturbild', 'Löschen', 'Hinzufügen' (disabled), 'Weiter'; two <video> blob previews
